_roles_doc: docs/team_roles.md; A-D identify the four assigned work packages and review responsibilities.
collaboration: **Lead and reviewer.** Each section has one lead and a different reviewer, who checks its code, numbers and wording.

**Shared work.** Scope and pre-registration (all four); preparation, bias and experiments as a chain (C finds, B implements, D evaluates, C interprets); conclusions and video (D merges the claims, A checks every number).

**Feedback.** Later findings changed earlier work before each freeze: redundancy and skewness led to new preparation steps; label disagreement led to the union label and the screening population; the leakage pilot led to the availability rule.

genai_workflow: **How AI was used.** The topic, research direction and the choice at each decision point were made by people; the detailed analysis design, the code and most of the text were drafted by AI, then reviewed, checked against the data and revised under the team's direction. Every member can explain the sections they lead.
